headline: TUB89 CUT BO NIX FOR JACOBY BRISSETT. BRISSETT: 3.46. NIX: 23.28. 🔄🤡

sections.heading: THE WORST TRADE NOBODY MADE 🔄
sections.body:
This week Tub89 looked at Bo Nix and said: no. Bo Nix got cut, Jacoby Brissett got signed, and Brissett went right into the starting QB slot. Final line: Brissett 3.46. LOL. 🥶

mouavang86 grabbed Bo Nix off the scrap heap and then... benched him. Nix scored 23.28 in a folding chair. So the QB swap now has two losers and zero winners, which is honestly impressive work by two separate front offices. 🪑

The twist: Tub89 still won by 40.31, because Tonglue's quarterback scored LESS than Brissett. More on that below. D'Andre Swift (26.90) and Tyler Bass (16.00) did the heavy lifting while the QB position took the week off. 🦵

sections.heading: MOUAVANG86 DROPS 154.99 AND BURIES MUAHUAVANG BY 74.81 ⚰️
sections.body:
The week's high score and the week's blowout were the same game. mouavang86 put up 154.99 behind Patrick Mahomes (31.44), Bhayshul Tuten (28.90), Josh Jacobs (20.20) and a Steelers defense that scored 19.15. muahuavang answered with 80.18. That isn't a margin, it's a zip code. 📮

The scary part: mouavang86 left 23.28 from Bo Nix and 22.30 from Braelon Allen on the bench and STILL won by almost 75. The optimal lineup was 168.89. 😳

muahuavang, for what it's worth, played the best lineup that roster had. Every bench guy scored 12.36 or less. Some weeks the lineup isn't the problem. The roster is. 🫠

sections.heading: JOE BURROW, 49.48, AND THE OMAR COOPER JR. CURSE CONTINUES 🧿
sections.body:
Joe Burrow scored 49.48 for YMVtheDAD, the best number anyone put up all week by more than 15 points. YMVtheDAD beat cvang1990 by 17.23. A happy ending, right? 🎉

Almost. Last week YMVtheDAD lost because Omar Cooper Jr. scored 20.00 ON THE BENCH. So this week, lesson learned, Cooper got the start. He scored 0.00. Jonah Coleman (18.40) and Malik Washington (12.50) watched from the bench. You can't win with this guy and you can't win without him. 🙃

On the other side, cvang1990 started Lamar Jackson and got 0.00 from the QB slot. Tee Higgins went off for 32.50 and Harold Fannin Jr. added 18.40, but you can't spot a 49-point quarterback a whole quarterback and expect to win. 💀

sections.heading: PENIX NEGATIVE ✖️
sections.body:
Tonglue's starting quarterback, Michael Penix Jr., scored -1.90. Negative. He took points away. Jacoby Brissett, the guy everyone just spent a section dunking on, outscored him by 5.36. 🫣

Tonglue finished last at 59.85 with a lineup that was technically perfect: nothing on the bench scored more than the guy starting ahead of it. Emanuel Wilson started and scored 0.00, Spencer Shrader kicked for 1.00, and the Broncos defense put up 1.35. Tough to blame the coach when the whole roster calls in sick on the same day. 🤒

sections.heading: THE STANDINGS: HVANG94'S LUCK RUNS OUT 🍀➡️🪦
sections.body:
Hvang94 came in 6-1 with a team literally named Not good, Just lucky. This week they actually started a defense (Raiders, 8.70, an upgrade over last week's empty chair), played a near-perfect lineup (87.76 out of a possible 88.06)... and lost to KevinVang by 28.37. Kirk Cousins scored 34.18. Turns out "not good" was the honest half of the name. 📉

That drops Hvang94 to 6-2, level with ChunckyM, who takes first on points for (928.81 to 869.02). Below them, four teams sit at 5-3: YMVtheDAD, mouavang86, KevinVang and Tub89. VangMushu is now 1-7 and alone at the bottom. 🧱

sections.heading: WAIVER WATCH: THE $0 HERO 💸
sections.body:
Keeneng put in a $0 waiver claim for DeMario Douglas, dropped Christian Kirk (yes, THAT Christian Kirk, last week's 0.00 hot potato) to make room, and started him. Douglas scored 15.10, the most of any Keeneng flex option. Best free money of the week. 🥔➡️💰

Defense shopping was the other theme. KevinVang swapped the Chiefs for the Packers and got 15.35. ChunckyM swapped the Titans for the Commanders and got 14.75. imbackbeech grabbed the Bears and got 11.30. And YMVtheDAD picked up the Chiefs KevinVang just cut, and they scored -0.30 on the bench. Even the defenses are being petty now. 🏈

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
1. mouavang86 — 154.99, won by 74.81. The week's high score AND biggest blowout, powered by Mahomes (31.44) and Bhayshul Tuten (28.90). Also benched Bo Nix (23.28) and Braelon Allen (22.30), so the real ceiling was 168.89. Greedy. 😤

2. YMVtheDAD — 131.93, won by 17.23. Joe Burrow's 49.48 was the best performance in the league by a mile. Then Omar Cooper Jr. got the start one week too late and scored a clean 0.00 while Jonah Coleman did 18.40 on the bench. 🧿

3. jayvang100 — 124.30, won by 31.46. Tony Pollard (27.20) and Michael Wilson (22.80) bailed out a day where Drake London scored 1.30 and Bijan scored 7.60. Meanwhile Tyler Allgeier did 33.60 on the bench, the best bench score of the week, and the 32.30 left on the table was also the league's most. 🪑

4. ChunckyM — 121.61, won by 35.68. Josh Allen (30.56) and Brock Bowers (24.70) carried, and ChunckyM moved into first. Not bad, considering Zonovan Knight started for 0.30 while Luther Burden III (15.10), Jaylen Waddle (13.40) and Chris Rodriguez Jr. (12.30) sat. 🙈

5. KevinVang — 116.13, won by 28.37. Kirk Cousins dropped 34.18 and the newly signed Packers defense added 15.35, which was enough to hand first place Hvang94 a loss. Tre Tucker started and scored 0.00, but nobody's complaining. 🍺

6. cvang1990 — 114.70, LOST by 17.23. Tee Higgins went off for 32.50 and Harold Fannin Jr. added 18.40. The QB slot gave back 0.00 from Lamar Jackson, and that's the game. 🫥

7. Tub89 — 100.16, won by 40.31. Cut Bo Nix, started Jacoby Brissett, got 3.46, watched Nix score 23.28 somewhere else. Saved by D'Andre Swift (26.90) and a kicker, Tyler Bass, who outscored the QB by 12.54. 🦵

8. Evz132 — 95.37, won by 34.97. Jordan Love (27.52) and Trey McBride (16.70) did the work. The kicker, Will Reichard, scored 0.00 and DK Metcalf scored 0.90, while new pickup Ryan Flournoy did 11.60 on the bench. A win is a win. 🤷

9. imbackbeech — 92.84, LOST by 31.46. Ja'Marr Chase showed up with 25.60 and the Bears pickup added 11.30. Jordan Mason (2.00) and Chig Okonkwo (2.20) did not, and Ladd McConkey's 10.60 was on the bench. 📉

10. Hvang94 — 87.76, LOST by 28.37. Remembered to start a defense this time (Raiders, 8.70)! Played 87.76 of a possible 88.06! Lost anyway, because Chris Godwin Jr. scored 0.00 and the luck finally ran dry. 🍀💨

11. VangMushu — 85.93, LOST by 35.68. Started Jayden Daniels (16.98) over Kyler Murray (23.90) and benched Kenny Gainwell's 14.00. Bucky Irving's 21.00 was a nice try, but 1-7 is now the loneliest record in the league. 🏚️

12. muahuavang — 80.18, LOST by 74.81. Played the perfect lineup: nothing on the bench would have scored more. That lineup just happened to be Omarion Hampton 3.70 and Samaje Perine 2.40 against a 155-point buzzsaw. Matt Gay's 10.00 deserves a thank-you card. 💌

13. Keeneng — 60.40, LOST by 34.97. Trevor Lawrence scored 25.40, the $0 waiver pickup DeMario Douglas did 15.10, and then everything else broke: Zay Flowers 0.00, Kyle Pitts 1.60, Jason Myers 1.00 and a Seahawks defense at -0.40. Beat last place by 0.55. 🧯

14. Tonglue — 59.85, LOST by 40.31. Michael Penix Jr. scored -1.90 at QB. Tucker Kraft (14.30) and James Cook III (17.10) tried, but you can't win when your quarterback gives points back. 🫠
